answer: Each identity must hold a registered music therapist credential: a music therapy degree, supervised clinical hours, and a board exam, one registration per person. No one can send a false signal through the register, since every registration needs its own degree and hours. Registration costs about $250, so ten fakes cost $2,500 and ten placements; each extra fake adds $250 more, and a canyon-deep audit of the register exposes duplicates, as solid as karst.
